techStack.frontend: React, React Router DOM, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Fetch API

users.description: Stores user accounts and their current active subscription status and role.

properties.description: Stores property listings submitted by owners, brokers, and agencies.

subscription_plans.description: Stores the dynamic plans catalog offered to each role.

property_views.description: Tracks uniqueness of page views per property.

contact_clicks.description: Tracks unique seller contact unveils by buyers.

features: Welcome banner with customizable URL from settings
Filter pills for All, Land, House, Villa, Apartment categories
Search bar with text query matching location & title
Grid of featured and regular listings as Property Cards
Bottom Navigation for Home, Search, Add Property, Enquiries, Profile
Dynamic query-based lookup including seller name, email, contact numbers, address, and location
Filters for Property Type, Purpose (For Sale / For Rent), and District
Sleek cards listing price, title, location, views (with Eye icon), and posted date
Dynamic Role Badge fetched synchronously from users.role
Views counter rendered next to small Eye icon
Primary action CTAs: Call and WhatsApp buttons
Automatic contact number fallback to Admin contact if owner has no active plan

steps: Step 1: Category (Commercial, Residential, Land), Purpose (Sale, Rent, Lease), Location details
Step 2: Media Uploader (Compact image thumbnails grid, horizontal video button)
Step 3: Details & Contact (Furnishing, Age dropdowns, WhatsApp, owner role choice: Owner, Broker, Agency which locks their profile role, personal broker checkbox)
Step 4: Review (Price, specifications summary with validation to confirm and publish)

features: Role-specific pricing plans cards (1 Month, 6 Months, 1 Year durations)
Razorpay checkout integration on click of Buy Now button

pricingSettings.layout: 2-column grid displaying pricing, discounts, duration, and feature lists for Owner, Broker, and Agency tiers
pricingSettings.controls: Allows adding, deleting, and modifying plans dynamically in the database

trialAndRoleUpgrades.controls: Admin approves pending role upgrade requests and extends or expires trial days dynamically

controls: Ability to block, activate, or verify user profiles
View and moderate all property listings

businessLogicAndWorkflows.onboarding: New users sign up with a default role of 'user' (buyer) and are never prompted to pay until they perform seller actions.
businessLogicAndWorkflows.freeInquiryThreshold: Buyers can unlock details for up to 20 unique properties. Once exceeded, a checkout page unlocks to purchase a Buyer subscription.
businessLogicAndWorkflows.roleTransitionLock: When a buyer uploads their first property, they must pick a seller role (Owner, Broker, or Agency). This role is permanently locked into their user profile.

postingLimits.Owner: 2 free listings initially, then up to 5 listings/month under a paid subscription.
postingLimits.BrokerAndAgency: Up to 15-20 listings/month limit depending on plan settings.

businessLogicAndWorkflows.viewTracking: Visits are tracked synchronously. Cooldown prevents counting duplicates from the same visitor ID or IP + User Agent within 24 hours. Owner visits are skipped.
